audit.evidence: Eighteen engines share one interface: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite, libSQL, DuckDB, MongoDB, Redis, Couchbase, ClickHouse, Druid, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Trino, Apache Cassandra, Prometheus and Apache Kafka, with the same explorer everywhere, and ER diagrams, schema diff and monitoring wherever the engine has something to report. Three of the eighteen are read-only because their own SQL is: Druid, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch have no `UPDATE` and no `CREATE TABLE` in the grammar at all, so those controls are reported as unsupported instead of failing when used.
